title: Phase 74 publishes evidence-synthesis, challenge, and decision-translation controls
summary: Thirty-two inactive result-input dockets and eight each of synthesis-contradiction, external-challenge, and decision-translation/reevaluation controls now expose the path between an adjudicated result and a challengeable, reversible recommendation. All result, synthesis, grade, challenge, recommendation, authorization, reevaluation, review, and receipt fields remain empty.
evidence_note: This release contains empty synthesis-input, contradiction, challenge-response, decision-translation, and reevaluation contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It does not contain an adjudicated result, effect, interval, evidence grade, body-level claim, contradiction decision, challenge, response, option, benefit, harm, recommendation, authorization, monitoring plan, sunset, reevaluation, correction, withdrawal, reviewer decision, or receipt.
publication_effect: Adds two Published briefings, one Published dependency map, one searchable registry with forty detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, cohort, stage, panel, design, result, claim, and operating states unchanged.
